Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE AND ANALYTICS [CSE-4018]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Compare different types of Business Analytics with suitable real-world examples, and  
  analyze how each type can support strategic decision-making in such an organization.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Given a retail business experiencing challenges in understanding customer behavior and  
  managing large volumes of transaction data, Illustrate how can Big Data Analytics be   (5)  
  applied to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.  
  
2)           Demonstrate different phases of Information Hierarchy graph in Business Intelligence  
  using a neat diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      A multinational e-commerce company wants to enhance its decision-making process  
  using Business Intelligence (BI) dimensions. The company deals with a large volume of  
  data related to sales, customer behaviour, and inventory management across multiple  
  regions.                                                                              (5)  
  Examine two important BI dimensions that the company should consider for analysing  
  its business performance and its contributions to strategic decision making.  
  
3)           With a neat diagram explain how does a value-driven approach influence BI  
  implementation and how organizations derive value from BI by effective information  
  (5)  
  usage.  
  A)  
  B)      A retail chain requires a real-time dashboard for monitoring in-store purchases and  
  online orders to adjust inventory dynamically. Illustrate with a neat diagram the high  
  architectural components of the BI system would need to be updated to support real-         (5)  
  time data processing and visualization.  
  
4)           Assume a fast-growing retail company wants to implement RFID. Discuss with the neat  
  diagram the working process of RFID tags in the retail company with its advantages.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      A company is using customer data to improve its marketing strategy through Business  
  Intelligence tools. Apply the concepts of privacy and ethics to this scenario underling the (5)  
  ethical considerations to be taken into account, ensuring responsible data usage.  
  
5)           A large e-commerce company wants to analyse customer behaviour using Big Data               (5)  
  analytics. They need to discover patterns in purchasing trends, identify high-value  
  customers, and detect fraud transactions. Since they handle large volumes of data, they

A)          prefer to use open-source technologies for cost-effectiveness and scalability.  
  Compare any two open-source Big Data technologies with its role in gaining insights  
  into customer behaviour and detect fraud transactions.  
  
  B)          A retail company collects massive amounts of customer transaction data. They want to  
  use Big Data analytics to understand customer buying behaviour and improve sales.  
  List any five predictive analytics methods/approaches used to recommend products with (5)  
  its role in Big Data framework to process large scale data.  
  
  
-----End-----
